answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Work waits on the velvet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the mirror of the next round. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. By the dawn of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
